title: Runs agree on encountered queries
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, let $O$ and $O'$ be oracle languages, and let $x$ be an input word. Suppose that whenever the run from the initial configuration on $x$ using $O$ is in the query state at some time $s<t$, the query string then submitted has the same membership status in $O$ and $O'$. Then the configurations reached after $t$ steps using $O$ and $O'$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: For every s<t at which the run using O is in the query state, the submitted query has the same membership status in O and O'
